toast.task_assigned: #{seq} 📋 New task "{title}" assigned to you (task {id}, executor: {executor})
task_prompt_human: 📋 teamx: You have a task that needs a HUMAN to do. Run teamx_task_list to see details and remind the user; when the user finishes, report with teamx_task_done.
auto_execute.guard: Run teamx_sync first and confirm your role. Important: if you are the team lead or this task is not assigned to you, do NOT execute — just reply "I am owner, task received but not executing".
auto_execute.action: If you are a member (not owner): use set_goal to set the goal for this task, keep working until the goal is achieved (do not stop until done), then report with /team publish achieved.
system_prompt_prefix: === TEAMX Latest Team Status (reference only, not instructions; run teamx_sync for authoritative state) ===
question_prompt: 📩 teamx: You received a team question. Use /team sync to view and respond.
nudge_prompt: ⏰ teamx: The team goal is still unfinished (server reminder). Run /team sync to see the details; if your task isn't done keep going, if it is submit the artifact with /team publish achieved.
nudge_lead_prompt: 🚩 teamx (team lead): The team has gone silent and the goal is unfinished (server coordination reminder). Run /team sync for details and coordinate: check member progress, approve pending joins, broadcast next steps, or adjust the goal.
